summary_md: **Kada 玩 AI ([@KadaPlaysAI](https://x.com/KadaPlaysAI/status/2116516776553128223))** built **sessift**, a TUI that searches AI coding sessions (Claude Code, Codex, Pi, OpenCode, Grok) across local and remote machines over SSH in about 30 ms and resumes them on Enter ([kadaliao/sessift](https://github.com/kadaliao/sessift), [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SglFk6oapYs)).
